text: The ___ of a semisimple Lie algebra is defined as the dimension of a Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$, equivalently the number of simple roots $|\Delta|$.
explanation: By definition the rank is $r = \dim\mathfrak{h} = |\Delta| = \dim V$. It is not the dimension of $\mathfrak{g}$ (which equals $r + |\Phi|$) nor the number of roots $|\Phi|$; both of those are strictly larger for any semisimple algebra.
